note: MIL-C-1318B (Amendment 5) (Military Specification: Cartridge, Caliber .50, Tracer, M17): The base specification is MIL-C-1318B dated 3 April 1985. This record is Amendment 5, dated 26 July 2000, which restates paragraphs 3.8 and 3.9 in full. The base document is not available on everyspec.com. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. MIL-C-1318B was inactivated for new design on 29 August 1997.

MIL-C-10190D (Military Specification: Cartridge, Caliber .50, Ball, M33): The source PDF is a scan with no text layer. Values were extracted with tesseract and checked against the page images. Amendment 4 (26 July 2000) adds an EPVAT alternative of 2905 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s at 78 ft and an EPVAT chamber pressure limit of 65,000 psi. The base values above do not change. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. It covers quality assurance and delivery for the M33 ball cartridge.

MIL-C-3066C (Military Specification: Cartridges, Caliber .50: Armor-Piercing-Incendiary, M8; and Armor-Piercing-Incendiary-Tracer, M20): One document covers the M8 API and the M20 API-T projectiles. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. Amendment 1 (26 July 2000) adds an EPVAT alternative of 2905 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s at 78 ft and EPVAT chamber pressure limits of 65,000 psi for the M8 API and 60,500 psi for the M20 API-T. The base values above do not change.

MIL-C-9963F (Cartridge, 5.56mm, Ball, M193): Velocity 3165 ft/s plus or minus 40 ft/s, measured 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F. The chamber pressure has two methods. The copper-crush cylinder average limit is 358.5 MPa (52,000 psi). The piezoelectric transducer average limit is 379.2 MPa (55,000 psi). The average plus three standard deviations limits are 400.0 MPa (58,000 psi) and 420.6 MPa (61,000 psi). The specification does not state bullet mass, barrel length or twist.

MIL-C-63989C (Cartridge, 5.56mm, Ball, M855): Velocity 3000 ft/s plus or minus 40 ft/s, measured 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F plus or minus 2 F. Chamber pressure 379.2 MPa (55,000 psi) is the average limit. The individual limit and the average plus three standard deviations limit are 420.6 MPa (61,000 psi). Twist is one turn in 7 in from the scope. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel length.

MIL-C-46934B (Military Specification: Cartridge, 7.62mm, NATO, Match, M118): Amendment 6 (11 March 1991) renames the cartridge from MATCH to SPECIAL BALL. It does not change the velocity or the chamber pressure. Accuracy requirement: the average of the mean radii at 600 yards shall not exceed 3.5 inches. Port pressure: 12,500 psi plus or minus 2,000 psi. The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. The propellant charge is checked against a 25 grain minimum.

MIL-C-46281F (Cartridge, 7.62mm: NATO, Tracer, M62): Velocity depends on the jacket type. The value is 2750 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s for gilding metal clad steel jackets. The value is 2680 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s for gilding metal jackets. Velocity is measured 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F. The chamber pressure has two methods. The copper-crush cylinder average limit is 344.7 MPa (50,000 psi). The EPVAT average limit is 365 MPa (52,940 psi). The average plus three standard deviations limits are 379.2 MPa (55,000 psi) and 400 MPa (58,016 psi). The specification does not state bullet mass, barrel length or twist.

MIL-C-46931F (Cartridge, 7.62mm: NATO, Ball, M80): Velocity 2750 ft/s plus or minus 30 ft/s, measured 78 ft from the muzzle, conditioned at 70 F. The chamber pressure has two methods. The copper-crush cylinder average limit is 344.7 MPa (50,000 psi). The EPVAT average limit is 365 MPa (52,940 psi). The average plus three standard deviations limits are 379.2 MPa (55,000 psi) and 400 MPa (58,016 psi). The specification does not state bullet mass, barrel length or twist.

MIL-PRF-32317 (Performance Specification: Cartridge, 7.62mm: Armor Piercing - M993): The specification does not state bullet mass or barrel twist. The cartridge interfaces with the M240 series machine gun and the M24 rifle. The document is distribution statement A.

MIL-C-70508 (Cartridge, 9mm, Ball, NATO, XM882): Velocity 385 m/s plus or minus 15 m/s, measured 16 m from the muzzle, conditioned at 21 C plus or minus 2 C. Chamber pressure 215 MPa is the corrected average peak limit at the case mouth. No individual peak pressure shall exceed 250 MPa. The specification designates the cartridge XM882. The specification does not state bullet mass, barrel length or twist.
